entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production final death key pose for a 2D game animation. Attached image is the approved original DESIGN AND SCALE AUTHORITY, not a rejected animation. Redraw exactly ONE complete talon-owl in the following new pose: The owl has collapsed onto its left breast and flank. Its same round spotted head rests with the left cheek at ground level, tilted moderately toward the left. The chest lies flat and the torso rolls slightly toward the viewer. Near wing has sagged out at the shoulder and rests diagonally on the floor, far wing rests partly open to the left; BOTH talons remain visibly connected by folded feathered legs, relaxed forward beside the lower cheek, no weight-bearing perch. Tail feathers rest flat toward the right. Fully closed eyes. Preserve exact spotted tan crown, ivory facial disks, dark beak, horn tufts, wing feather scale, head size and torso volume. No new necklace-like neck fluff, no smooth empty sockets, no floating toes, no flying silhouette. Keep the original polished painted cartoon style, thin colored-dark contour, lighting, palette, recognizable pattern details, unchanged anatomical proportions and three-quarter camera. The pose may change occlusions and expose hidden surfaces, but the same skull, torso, limb lengths, ears, feathers and wool clusters must be identifiable. Fixed square canvas with generous transparent margins, same character physical scale as the reference. Feet/body/cheek contact one horizontal floor around 85% down the canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background. No floor artwork, cast shadow, debris, particles, effects, text, labels, grid, multiple characters, gore or animation sheet. This drawing will become actual production key-pose and part source.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Production MIDDLE COLLAPSE KEY for a 2D game death animation. Image 1 is the approved upright original design and physical-scale authority. Image 2 is the selected final death drawing, ONLY to establish the destination pose. Draw exactly ONE complete intermediate pose, no sheet: The owl's ankles and knees have folded, the chest has dropped halfway toward the floor, and its body is tipping toward the front-left breast. The spotted head nods forward with half-closed eyes, its skull still the same size. The near wing has loosened at the shoulder and opened slightly outward, wing tip trails and is almost touching the ground. The far wing is visible spreading a little leftward for balance. Both talons fold forward on the floor at the real connected legs, with no dangling foot silhouettes. Tail follows late to the right. This is an unstable collapsing pose between the upright perch and the final left-breast rest. Match image 1 exactly in head dimensions, torso volume/length, limb and ear lengths, distinctive surface markings/wool clusters/feather patterns, style, lighting and palette. Keep the same three-quarter camera. Match image 2's final identity without prematurely reaching that final pose. Do not enlarge the head or flatten the torso. Fixed square canvas, generous transparent margins, same physical scale as the images, same horizontal ground plane. True transparent RGBA alpha. No floor or cast-shadow drawing, no effects, particles, gore, text, labels, grid, multiple characters or motion trails. This key will be used as an actual anatomy/occlusion source for local rig intervals and transitions.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Actual production layered anatomical source kit for a hybrid 2D death animation. Image1 is the APPROVED ORIGINAL design authority; image2 is the new final-collapse key for joint/overlap guidance. Nine separate parts in a 3 by 3 atlas: row1 complete chest/torso without head,wings,legs,tail; complete spotted head with ivory facial disks, closed eyes and dark beak, but WITHOUT horn tufts or a chest/neck feather collar; full near wing from shoulder through elbow/wrist to intact primaries in a slightly relaxed partly open pose. Row2 full far wing slightly open; complete near feathered leg from hidden hip through knee/ankle to three relaxed dark talons; complete far feathered leg/talons. Row3 full tail fan; original left horn tuft; original right horn tuft. Preserve exactly the approved original head shape, all spotted crown and wing feather markings, chest feather proportions and original foot scale. Wing roots are natural feather surfaces, not circular sockets. Every attachment is individually complete, continuous, independently separated by generous transparent space, hidden contours fully painted with natural rounded fur/feather/wool, no stump cross sections, flat sliced planes, holes or outlined socket circles. Preserve exact design/texture motifs, palette, line weight, original anatomical proportions and three-quarter view. Parts are in neutral orientation for one-time anatomical registration; no animation frames. All parts should be large enough for clean extraction and full detail. True transparent RGBA alpha. No gray/white backgrounds, checkerboards, shadows, labels, text, borders, frames, grid lines, arrows, extra parts or assembled characters.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Exact production expression attachment edit. Edit ONLY the eyes of this isolated talon-owl head to open alert golden eyes with the exact original iris shapes. Preserve every other pixel and silhouette: identical skull size and shape, same wool clumps/feather spots/fur markings, same nose, beak, forehead, cheek volume and colors. Keep the head in exactly the same position and orientation on the same square transparent canvas with the same margins. No ears, horns, torso, neck, added collars or other objects. Do not recenter, zoom, resize, rotate or redraw the head design. True transparent alpha background. This actual alternate eye artwork will be precisely registered and composited into the locked head attachment, keeping the original geometry.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Actual production layered BODY POSE source atlas for this SAME talon-owl death action. Its head will be rendered from one separate locked attachment. Image1 is approved original design and exact body/limb size authority. Image2 is the selected middle-collapse key; image3 is the final-rest destination. Draw SIX HEADLESS BODY POSES in a clean 3-column by 2-row atlas, chronological row-major order. Remove the ENTIRE skull, ivory facial disks, eyes, beak, horn tufts and all facial feathers in every cel. Draw the complete feathered chest and flexible hidden neck base under the absent head as a solid natural connected torso. Include both wings, both full connected feathered legs and relaxed dark talons, and the complete tail fan. The head removal must have no empty holes, visible sockets, flat neck cuts, extra head-shaped balls, chopped surfaces or outlined attachment rings. Keep original anatomical proportions, torso volume, limb and wing/tail lengths, recognizable fur/feather markings, original colors, painted style, line weight, lighting and same 3/4 view. Each body+appendages is anatomically connected. SAME PHYSICAL SCALE in all six cells, same horizontal floor and ample transparent margins and gutters. Do not enlarge, shrink, arbitrarily flatten or stretch any body region between cells. Action: 1 normal upright original perch with folded wings and connected feet. 2 ankles/knees start buckling and the chest drops a little, wings loosen at shoulders. 3 chest and forebody drop halfway, folded knees/ankles and talons relax forward, near wing starts falling open outward. 4 breast contacts the floor while rear body and tail are still descending, wings partly open at shoulders and tips nearly grounded. 5 same original-volume torso rests on its left breast/flank, complete relaxed connected talons forward, near and far wings rest on floor, tail partly settled toward right. 6 same final core body as5 with the wings/tail finishing a small delayed sag; do not redraw or change the core body proportions. These are actual production body cels. True transparent RGBA background. No head/eyes/ears/horns/face, cast shadow, floor artwork, background glow, gray gradient, labels, text, grid lines, borders, loose pieces, duplicated limbs, gore or effects.
